theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: As the leading eligible theme with a 'trend' hurst tag and no crowding, it benefits from the validated absolute-trend gate's risk-control properties (lower vol, shallower drawdowns) even though cross-sectional momentum has no forward edge. The overweight is conditional on sustained eligibility and leadership structure.
